source_title: Reddit final IPO prospectus dated March 20, 2024
unit: Issued share counts are shares. Contract issue prices are USD per preferred share. Aggregate proceeds, preferences, carrying values and owner targets are USD million. Conversion ratios are common shares per preferred share.
locator: Consolidated Balance Sheets, F-3, December 31, 2023 actual column. Note 12, F-23 to F-25, preferred-capital table, Dividends and Conversion. Note 13, F-25, common stock rights.
facts: Issued and outstanding common stock is 7,099,700 Class A and 53,904,204 Class B shares. The preferred table records 73,021,449 shares in nine series, with the per-series counts, aggregate liquidation preferences and net carrying amounts retained in preferred. These are actual balances, not IPO pro forma shares or authorized shares. Each preferred series has a 1:1 common-stock conversion ratio. Series F-1 converts to Class A and the others to Class B. No dividends were declared or paid through December 31, 2023. Common A and B economic rights are identical, while votes per share differ.

facts: Original issue prices by series are A 2.6667, A-1 5.9259, B 6.2631, C 15.7739, D and D-1 21.6863, E 42.4742, F and F-1 61.7944 USD. Series A has a 1.75-times liquidation preference. unit: Issued share counts are shares. Contract issue prices are USD per preferred share. Aggregate proceeds, preferences, carrying values and owner targets are USD million. Conversion ratios are common shares per preferred share.
locator: Pre-IPO certificate, sections IV.E.3(a), IV.E.3(c)-(d), pp. 15-16, and IV.E.5(p)(i), p. 26.
facts: A Liquidation Event valuing the company at more than USD 240,000,000 automatically converts Series A and A-1 into Class B common stock. Residual proceeds go to common holders in proportion to shares. Preferred holders are deemed converted when conversion would deliver a greater aggregate distribution. A converted holder no longer receives a preferred distribution. Other conversion triggers include a qualified public offering and specified shareholder elections.

facts: Unconverted A-1 ranks after the other preferred series and before common. Senior shortfalls are allocated by full preference. Holders may convert 1:1 instead. A and A-1 automatically convert in a liquidation valuing Reddit above USD 240 million. Common classes have equal economic rights.

facts: sale_cases and owner_targets are authored sensitivities, not observed transactions or issuer forecasts. For these hypothetical cash liquidations, trigger valuation equals the proceeds distributable to the listed issued stock. Issued capital and displayed charter terms remain frozen. All necessary approvals are assumed, with no waiver, new dividends or other conversion event. Unissued awards and all other claims are settled outside this pool without new shares. No amount for those excluded settlements is supplied or inferred.
